summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration work with Spark, including updates on Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features. Proposals for the REST Catalog and enhancements to access policies and metadata management have also been prominent topics.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes document integration work and discussions
Proposals for the REST Catalog and first-class Tag concept
Discussion on adding finer grained read restrictions in loadTable response
Efforts to improve read performance and compaction efficiency in Spark
